title: SourceState
description: Ephemeral local source view. Cargo metadata path packages supply the repository source closure; unavailable metadata conservatively selects the whole checkout. Git trees describe HEAD, and clean/status cover those same paths. No persisted authority or network head.

closureCid.description: Raw CIDv1 of sorted UTF-8 path, TAB, Git tree object id, LF lines.

closure.description: Sorted repository-relative paths and committed tree identities; a gitlink uses its pinned commit object id. A dot path means the complete checkout.
